description: Named types of the bot API. Encodings follow E34 and E35.

types.name: Square
types.description: rank * 8 + file, a1 = 0 to h8 = 63; NO_SQUARE = 64.

types.name: Bitboard
types.description: Set of squares; bit i stands for square i.

types.name: CastlingRights
types.description: Bit set of WHITE_KINGSIDE, WHITE_QUEENSIDE, BLACK_KINGSIDE, BLACK_QUEENSIDE.

types.name: Move
types.description: Move as 16-bit value: bits 0 to 5 from-square, 6 to 11 to-square, 12 to 15 flags (E34). Two moves are equal if their values are equal. NULL_MOVE and RESIGN are special values with from-square equal to to-square, never legal moves.

types.name: Board
types.description: Chess position with move history, backed by the shared core. The binding owns the native handle and frees it with the language's memory management.

types.name: Clock
types.description: Local view of the time situation during choose_move. The referee's clock is authoritative.

types.name: Bot
types.description: Base class the bot author extends; the SDK calls its callbacks.

types.name: Log
types.description: Debug log, written to stderr on the server (static functions only).

types.name: GameInfo
types.description: Game parameters from init, passed to on_game_start.

fields.name: increment_ms
fields.description: Time added after each own move.

fields.name: memory_limit_mib
fields.description: Fixed memory protection limit of the sandbox (A14).

types.name: GameResult
types.description: End of the game from game_over, passed to on_game_end.

fields.name: termination
fields.description: Termination code as listed in the protocol (E44).

types.name: Info
types.description: Search information sent with the move (E43); shown publicly in the viewer. Limits as in the protocol schema; the SDK truncates pv and text instead of failing.

fields.name: score_cp
fields.description: Score in centipawns from the bot's point of view; not together with score_mate.

fields.name: score_mate
fields.description: Mate in this many moves, negative if the bot gets mated; not 0.

fields.name: pv
fields.description: Principal variation starting with the move played; at most 32 moves are sent.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Free text; at most 256 characters are sent.
